sources.snippet: The checkpoint belongs to the continuation run stage2_npc_text_mtp-retrain-from-grad14000-20260825T022321Z. It was loaded back successfully with 454 model tensors, 140 optimizer states, step 60,000, grad step 30,000, and learning rate 1e-4. Only evaluation files are published here; optimizer and RNG state are intentionally omitted.
